answer: Attention Throughput Receipts ties each identity to a rolling ledger of verified dwell time: an agent must spend real processing cycles watching a mesa of live sensor feeds before its votes count. The rule enforces that only identities maintaining continuous, costly attention across a meadow of concurrent streams retain standing, so a sybil operator must fund parallel attention for every fake persona. Scaling to an orchard of identities multiplies that per-identity attention cost linearly, making sustained deception economically self-defeating.
